items.q: Yes. Louis Russell. And they had a band, they played in the Saratoga Club.

ctx.x: Yes. Louis Russell. And they had a band, they played in the Saratoga Club. So that's when Red became famous. And Red played a solo on the thing called, "You Gave Me Everything But Love." And he played, I think it was the Apollo -- I think it was the other theater, I forget the name but I'll get it in a few minutes, and he played a solo on that. And the solo was so soulful that he became famous for that.
And Red Allen had that thing, that same New Orleans or Louisiana delivery, And it would remind you of Louis Armstrong, because he'd do the same thing effect.
